about_the_game:
Who said being a courier is easy? In the world of Delivery Up, even gravity is against you. Your route leads through complex and unique segments — from steep mountain slopes to unstable sky-high structures. Every 1000 meters, a hungry NPC customer awaits: deliver the food, save your progress at the checkpoint, and climb even higher.

The Golden Rule

Your backpack is your lifeline. Touch the ground with it twice, and it’ll fall — you’ll have to go back down to retrieve it, or your path to the next level will be blocked. Decide whether to push forward or play it safe.

Hop on the Moped

Need speed? Instantly switch to a moped anytime to zoom past tricky sections. But be careful — riding in mid-air is even harder than walking.

Key Features

  • Vertical Challenge: a game for those seeking trials in the spirit of only up — a constant climb where each mistake can cost you hundreds of meters. Jump, climb, and balance your way through 3D space.

  • Backpack Mechanics: two hits and your delivery falls. You’ll need to go back down or fail the mission.

  • Interactive Gameplay: moving platforms, traps, spinning objects, physics-based items, and even labyrinths to overcome on your way up.

  • Moped: instantly switch to a vehicle for quick maneuvers or long jumps.

  • Checkpoint Clients: deliver food to NPCs and save your progress to start from a new height after falling.

  • Time Capsules: collect special capsules to rewind time and undo mistakes.

  • Choose Your Style: from trainee mode with frequent saves and unlimited time capsules to express delivery with no saves and no rewinds. Perfect for both casual play and speedruns.

Prepare for a journey where every meter counts and every order has its own fate. Take on the challenge of Delivery Up and prove that the best path to a customer’s heart runs straight through the clouds!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 / Intel (Metal)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: iGPU M1 / AMD (Metal)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1/M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 560, 2 GB VRAM

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Delivery Up is a chaotic vertical platformer about a stunt courier who must climb 10,000 meters to deliver every order on time. Lose your footing — but don’t lose your backpack!
